name: slideshot
description: Render HTML slides to high-resolution PNG, WebP, PDF, and PPTX using Puppeteer. Generate carousels for LinkedIn, Instagram, and presentations with a guided AI workflow.
long_description: Slideshot converts HTML into pixel-perfect slide images and documents. Give it HTML with `.slide` divs and it renders each one as a high-resolution PNG, WebP, combined PDF (now with @page-aware single-page-per-slide output), or editable/image-based PPTX — ready for LinkedIn carousels, Instagram posts, pitch decks, or presentation decks. Includes 8 built-in prompt templates (generic, branded, instagram-carousel, infographic, pitch-deck, dark-modern, editorial, browser-shell), a token-efficient `token_saver` mode for structured slide JSON, an `edit_slides` patch tool for iterating without regenerating, and a guided creation workflow with persistent preferences.

tools.name: discover_themes
tools.description: MANDATORY first step — returns the full theme catalog (8 themes, primary + secondary tiers), orientation presets, token modes, output formats, persisted user preferences, and 3 quick-start presets. Resets the discovery gate.

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: Idempotent read-only listing of every theme. Call mid-conversation if the user asks 'what other themes are there?' without resetting the create_slides flow.

tools.name: create_slides
tools.description: Save HTML slides to disk for later rendering. Two modes: mode='default' (AI writes a full HTML document — best quality, full creative control) or mode='token_saver' (AI sends a structured JSON `slides[]` array; the server assembles HTML from built-in templates — fewer tokens, lighter styling). Returns htmlPath; show as a code preview artifact and STOP — do not render in the same turn.

tools.name: edit_slides
tools.description: Token-efficient partial edits on a previously-saved deck. Operations: replace_slide (swap one slide block by 1-indexed slideIndex), patch_css (append CSS rules), swap_token (replace a CSS variable's value), patch_class (add/remove a class on a slide). Saves 60-90% tokens vs regenerating the whole HTML.

tools.name: render_slides
tools.description: Render saved HTML to PDF, WebP, PNG, and/or PPTX. Accepts htmlPath or html string. Supports orientation presets, custom width/height, scale (1-6), webpQuality, slideRange, native or image PPTX modes. PDF and PNG outputs are now byte-aligned via shared @page CSS reset and font-render-hinting=none.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Verify Puppeteer/Chromium can launch in this environment. Run first to diagnose render failures.
